about: Speedy Blupi Demo of June 1998 (docs/SB1_DEMO.md): its own source tree games/sb1-blupi-demo/src, an earlier revision of the SB1 source, verified against its own executable (targets.json sb1/blupi/demo, oracle/sb1-blupi-demo-tree). All addresses are the demo's own. tools/verify.py --target sb1/blupi/demo [--accept].

crt_data_evidence.purpose: bind __pgmptr only when the unique CRT code reference and its zero-filled definition resolve to the same oracle data address

standalone_link.provenance: Ordinary-build settings inherited from the SB1 manifest (recon.json) when the June demo got its own tree on 2026-11-11; not a claim of original linker-input identity.

withdrawal_history.reason: Removing a duplicate animation-selector draft body that the original did not have from decblupi.cpp changed IsDeepWater's emitted coordinate order (decblupi.cpp TU context). Same class as the earlier GetBlupiInfo withdrawal: preceding decblupi bodies are still incomplete; restore by completing them, never by keeping the non-original duplicate.

Removing the stale duplicate MoveObjectPollution body from decmove.cpp (the function belongs to decblupi.cpp at 0xfc10; two definitions could not have linked) shifted decmove.cpp TU context and MoveObjectSort became MISMATCH. Restore by finding the genuine decmove.cpp context (missing/extra declarations or bodies), never by keeping the duplicate.

accepted_functions.note: [EVIDENCE] June 1998 demo true-color-free Create API; all fixups verified.
